column1: # Scored correctness suite (v3) — graded BY NAME against baseline_manifest.json.
#   blargg : pass iff the want status-word appears in serial output AND the
# trap.gb is deliberately NOT in this list: it speaks the mooneye exit protocol
# (load Fibonacci registers, ld b,b breakpoint, spin forever — no serial
# signature ever; authored to test gb810's debugger hook, see NOTES §2 and
# test/micro/make.py t_trap). A black-box serial runner cannot grade it, so it
# ran as a permanently-failing denominator slot in v2. It now runs as a
# silent-clean-exit DIAGNOSTIC only (suite_run.sh emits it after the suite).
